map.：建筑原值 500 万元，耐用年限 50 年、已使用 20 年 → 年限法成新率: : original construction cost 5 million CNY, service life 50 years and 20 years used give an age of (50 - 20) / 50 = 40% by the age method; the scoring method on structure, decoration and equipment gives 55%; taking the mean gives 47.5%, so the appraised value = 500 x 47.5% = 2.375 million CNY, and residual value = 500 x the residual value rate.
